name: Hand-Held Spotlight
summary: A black-and-white hand offers your product in full colour against one bold field of colour.
works_for: Apps, cards, gadgets and small products. Upload an app screenshot and it goes on a phone.
default_colors: vivid emerald fading to near black at the lower corners
prompt:
Create a 4:5 vertical advertisement for {{BRAND}}, featuring {{PRODUCT}} (category: {{CATEGORY}}).

Composition: a single hand reaches up from the lower right, holding the product from Image 1 towards the viewer, slightly tilted, large and sharply in focus, taking up the right two thirds of the frame. If Image 1 is an app or screen screenshot, show it unaltered on a modern unbranded smartphone held in the hand. The hand and arm are in rich black and white so that only the product is in full colour.

Background: one smooth field of {{COLORS}}, brightest behind the product.

Headline: on the left in the upper half, a clean modern sans in white, on up to three tight lines, reading exactly: "{{HEADLINE}}".

Supporting line: directly under the headline, small and white, reading exactly: "{{SUBHEAD}}".

Brand: the logo if supplied, otherwise the name "{{BRAND}}" in a small white rounded label, at the upper left.

Call to action: small white text at the lower right of the frame, reading exactly: "{{CTA}}".

Finish: high-end studio light, crisp edge light on the hand, deep clean shadows, premium and uncluttered.

copy_brief.style: Plain-spoken and confident, one clear promise a person can believe.
copy_brief.headline_note: A simple statement, not a slogan.

motion_prompt: The hand makes a small, natural tilt towards the camera, and light glides once across the product. The background stays still. All text stays perfectly still and legible.
